name: HabboToolbarCom
manifest:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<manifest>

	<component class="com.sulake.bootstrap.HabboToolbarBootstrap" version="0.0">

		<interface iid="com.sulake.iid.IIDHabboToolbar" />

		<assets>

            <!-- Toolbar -->
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="toolbar_view_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="bottom_bar_left_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="bottom_background_border_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="new_items_label_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="me_menu_view_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="me_menu_new_view_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="me_menu_settings_menu_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="me_menu_sound_settings_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="me_menu_other_settings_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="toolbar_chat_settings_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="prog_menu_view_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="custom_word_filter_settings_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="custom_word_filter_item_xml" />

            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="extension_grid_xml" />

            <!-- Help / Logout / Room Tools -->
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="logout_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="logout_confirmation_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="roomtools_xml" />

			<asset mimeType="image/png" name="roominfo_icon" />

            <!-- Purse -->
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="purse_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="purse_indicator_credits_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="purse_indicator_pixels_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="purse_indicator_seasonal_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="purse_indicator_club_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="settings_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="setting_category_xml" />

            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="promo_duckets_xml" />

            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="icon_credit_0_png" />
            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="icon_credit_1_png" />
            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="icon_credit_2_png" />
            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="icon_credit_3_png" />
            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="icon_credit_4_png" />
            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="icon_credit_5_png" />
            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="icon_credit_6_png" />

            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="icon_pixel_0_png" />
            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="icon_pixel_1_png" />
            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="icon_pixel_2_png" />
            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="icon_pixel_3_png" />

            <!-- Club Status Bar -->
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="club_discount_promotion_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="extend_hilite_png" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="vip_discount_promotion_v2_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="vip_quests_promo_xml" />

            <!-- Super saver ads video offer  -->
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="video_offer_promotion_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="image/png" name="offer_icon_png" />

            <!-- Offer center -->
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="offer_extension_xml" />

            <!-- Phone number -->
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="phonenumber_collect_xml" source="phonenumber/collect.xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="phonenumber_verify_xml" source="phonenumber/verify.xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="phonenumber_collect_minimized_xml" source="phonenumber/collect_minimized.xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="phonenumber_verify_minimized_xml" source="phonenumber/verify_minimized.xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="phonenumber_country_menu_item_xml" source="phonenumber/country_menu_item.xml" />

            <!-- nux -->
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="nux_offer_old_user_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="nux_gift_selection_xml" />
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="nux_noob_room_offer_xml" />

            <!-- Return user gifting -->
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="returnusergifting_miniview_xml" source="returnusergifting/miniview.xml" />

            <!-- Campaign calendar -->
            <asset mimeType="text/xml" name="campaign_calendar_xml" source="campaign/calendar/calendar.xml" />

        </assets>

	</component>

</manifest>
